what: Each digit of a big number has a vertical strip. While scrolling, the strips roll different lengths per digit (longer toward the center digits, 0~9 over several turns) and stop from the start value to the end value — outer digits .8 · inner digits 1 length, each digit .02 later, power3.inOut. If the leading digit of the end value is empty it stops on blank, and on entering the screen the strip rises from 150% below in .8s expo.out

options.to: End value (characters), default 1 — if digits are short, pad the front with blanks
options.spins: Number of turns the center slot rotates, default 2 — each ring further out gets one fewer turn

note: The original used hand-written number tables (4, 17, 30, 31 cells) per spot — the part builds that shape (short outside, long inside) from the number of rings
